AsyncRuntimeHostLease.description:
Sticky exe.dev host binding for the org's Async Intern (WP2 S2).

Reported because the lease is what *accrues* the idle burn above: a lease
held across a quiet night is the usual explanation for a ceiling trip that
no single cycle appears to account for.
AsyncRuntimeHostLease.title: AsyncRuntimeHostLease

AsyncRuntimeSpend.description:
Observed Async burn against the ceilings in ``AsyncRuntimeBudget``.

# See: intern_async_24_7_change_scope.md (WP2 S1/S2, Downstream acceptance)

``AsyncRuntimeBudget`` states only what the org is *allowed* to spend. A
caller watching for the day/month trip to ``BlockAsync`` needs the other
half — what has actually been spent — and needs it in the same projection,
because the trip is a comparison of the two. Totals include both billed LLM
spend and the ``intern_sticky_host`` wall-time idle burn (WP2 S2), which is
the component most likely to exhaust a ceiling while nobody is watching.
AsyncRuntimeSpend.title: AsyncRuntimeSpend

AsyncStatus.description:

compat until a deliberate drop): ``CHECKPOINTING``, ``AWAITING_INPUT``
(Effort-level only now), ``CANCELLING``, ``FAILED``. Prefer
``packages.intern.async_.phase.derive_phase`` for new readers.
# See: INTERN_ASYNC_RUNTIME_PHASE_REFACTOR_HANDOFF_2026-08-08.md
AsyncStatus.title: AsyncStatus

project-scope stored-file inventory when no internal-git identity exists.

attached after the latest git commit cannot disappear from the receipt.

get.description:
Bounded keyword search over this org's Intern memory.

Deliberately a thin binding over ``services/intern/memory_search.py`` — the
same call the ``smr_intern_memory_search`` MCP tool makes. Reimplementing
retrieval here would let the agent's memory and the operator's memory drift
apart, and the bounds (query length, limit ceiling, allowed kinds) are
enforced once, in the service, for both callers.

Fetch one memory hit by the stable ``kind:id`` handle search returned.

An unknown or malformed handle is the service's typed refusal
(``intern_memory_get_not_found`` / ``intern_memory_get_hit_id_invalid``),
not a 500.

SmrRuntimeStreamTerminalPayload.description:
Final frame emitted when a run is terminal by durable contract.

The runtime stream reads Redis control-plane state only. Once that snapshot
is gone there will never be another runtime event for the run, and the
durable terminal receipt (``SmrRunTerminalOutcome`` / ``smr_run_terminations``)
is the sole remaining authority. This payload carries the terminal fact
in-band so an SSE consumer terminalises on the stream it is already parsing
instead of reconnecting against a refusal.
SmrRuntimeStreamTerminalPayload.title: SmrRuntimeStreamTerminalPayload
